headline_marked: 2 police injured as [[banned Chhatra League and Jubo League activists attack]] in Gopalganj
headline: 2 police injured as banned Chhatra League and Jubo League activists attack in Gopalganj
summary: Activists from the banned organizations attacked a police vehicle and injured two officers after being stopped from holding a processiony
details: Two police officers were injured when activists from the banned Chhatra League and Jubo League attacked a police vehicle in the Raghunathpur area of Gopalganj Sadar upazila.
The incident occurred around 3 PM on Saturday, October 24, in the Burimar Gashtala area.
According to police, a patrol team stopped activists from the banned organizations from holding a procession.
Enraged by the restriction, the attackers used local weapons and sticks to attack the police vehicle and the officers.
The police vehicle was vandalized during the clash.
Gopalganj Sadar Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Md. Aminul Islam confirmed the incident.
Police are currently conducting operations to arrest the attackers.

headline: 1,898 hospitalized in 24 hours as 6 more die from dengue
summary: The national death toll has reached 377 this year, with 132 fatalities recorded in October alone, according to the DGHS.
details: Six people died from dengue and 1,898 were hospitalised across Bangladesh in the last 24 hours, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
This brings the total number of dengue deaths in the country this year to 377, with 132 of those fatalities occurring in October alone.
September was the most severe month this year, recording 43,774 hospitalisations and 148 deaths.
In the last 24 hours, 159 patients were admitted to hospitals in Dhaka North City Corporation and 341 in Dhaka South City Corporation.
Other areas of the Dhaka Division logged 281 admissions, while Khulna reported the highest number of admissions outside the capital, with 359 patients.
